archetypes.name: delegation-surface
archetypes.rationale: Progress output now depends wholly on the shell renderer argv and timeout contract.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the progress_report delegation surface. Verify missing renderer, subprocess errors, timeout handling, markdown stripping, token-ledger forwarding, and skill-specific rounds roots still behave as intended after removing the Python chart path. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: doc-ci-drift
archetypes.rationale: CI and docs removed Mermaid setup claims while the dedicated Mermaid lint job remains.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the CI and documentation changes for drift. Confirm only the shard-12 renderer Mermaid setup was removed, the lint-mermaid job remains intact, and linting docs no longer imply the renderer harness requires mmdc. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
